Meredith Shapiro works as a food educator and freelance writer out of her home and teaches healthy cooking classes to both adults and children in the area. She is a mother to three children, all under the age of seven and her husband works as a medic in the Canadian military. Although Shapiro is educated in all aspects of nutrition, she focuses on realistic clean eating with a spotlight on healthy family habits. She is known online as The Nutritionnaire and writes a weekly blog while contributing to YMC on ABC Kitchen. In her downtime, she enjoys being outdoors with her family and relaxing at home with her husband and a well-deserved glass of wine.
